meta.name: markdown-converter
meta.description: Convert documents and files to Markdown using markitdown. Use when converting PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx, .xls), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images (with EXIF/OCR), audio (with transcription), ZIP archives, YouTube URLs, or EPubs to Markdown format for LLM processing or text analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将各种文档转为Markdown用于AI或文本分析
copy.tagline_en: Convert PDF, Word and more to Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert various documents to Markdown for AI or text analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以将PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、图片（含EXIF/OCR）、音频（含转录）、ZIP、YouTube链接、EPub等文件转换为Markdown格式，保留标题、表格、列表等结构。
howto.when: 当你说“把这个文件转成Markdown”或提供文件链接时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份PDF转换成Markdown格式。
say.note: Claude会调用工具转换并输出Markdown内容。

say.text: 把这个Word文档转成Markdown存到文件。
把Excel表格内容转换为Markdown表格。
say.note: Claude会提取表格数据并输出Markdown格式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can convert various documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images with EXIF/OCR, audio with transcription, ZIP, YouTube URLs, EPub) to Markdown, preserving headings, tables, lists, and links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'convert this file to Markdown' or provide a file/link for conversion.

say_en.text: Convert this PDF to Markdown for me.
say_en.note: Claude will convert and output Markdown content.

say_en.text: Convert this Word doc to Markdown and save to file.
say_en.note: Claude will convert and save it as a .md file.

say_en.text: Turn this Excel spreadsheet into Markdown tables.
say_en.note: Claude will extract table data and output Markdown format.
